title: VoxelCore generator biomes
description: Biome definitions (generators/<name>.files/biomes.toml). The file is a combined object: the same path in other packs is merged into it.
markdownDescription: Biome definitions (`generators/<name>.files/biomes.toml`). The file is a combined object: the same path in other packs is merged into it.

parameters.markdownDescription:
weights and central values of the parameters for the biome. See the [biome selection](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#biome-selection) section. The number of entries must match the number of biome selection parameters.

Needs at least `biome-parameters` entries (from the generator `.toml`).

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#biomes)
parameters.description:
weights and central values of the parameters for the biome. See the biome selection section. The number of entries must match the number of biome selection parameters.

Needs at least biome-parameters entries (from the generator .toml).

layers.markdownDescription:
block layers from top to bottom.

- `height` - layer height in blocks. -1 is used to mark the filler layer, of which there can only be one. Its height is calculated automatically.
- `block` - full block name
- `below-sea-level` - whether the layer can be generated below sea level (example: turf). If false, when generated below sea level, the layer will be replaced by the next one.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#biomes)

ocean layers. The position of the top layer coincides with the sea level height.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/world-generator.md#biomes)

plant-chance.markdownDescription:
probability of generating a plant on a surface block.

Default: `0`.

plants.markdownDescription:
plants randomly placed on the surface.

- `weight` - weight directly affecting the chance of selecting a specific plant.
- `block` - plant block
